The global**Artificial Limbs Market**is witnessing steady growth, driven by advancements in prosthetic technologies, rising incidences of limb amputations, and increased healthcare spending.

Valued at**US$ 2.3 billion in 2022**, the market is expected to expand at a**compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 5.1%**from**2023 to 2031**, surpassing**US$ 3.5 billion**by the end of the forecast period.
The demand for artificial limbs has been growing steadily due to an increasing number of amputations resulting from accidents, diabetes, vascular diseases, and congenital disabilities.
Technological advancements, including bionic limbs, 3D printing, and AI-driven prosthetics, are transforming the industry and improving the quality of life for amputees worldwide.
“The artificial limbs market is evolving rapidly, with innovations enhancing mobility, comfort, and functionality for patients.
